verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet operations platform, so a robotics buyer can fairly ask about simulation. However, the evidence documents only telemetry ingestion, teleoperation, analytics, commands and orchestration for real devices, with nothing on physics or sensor-model simulation. The ThreeJS toolkit is for custom 3D visualization of robots, not simulation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can simulate my robot and its environment with realistic physics and sensor models before touching hardware
